title: Hoofcraft
description: A mod that adds Mlp blocks and items that were moved from the Scholar Whooves mod to this mod.
body:
## About
An MLP-inspired Mod adds building blocks and items. This is a mod add-on for the SW mod; most of the MLP-related stuff was removed from SW and moved here.

## Features
Two new woodpacks, Elements of Harmony Ores, Shards, and Gems, Tree of Harmony structure, new tree structure, Food items, and stuff.

## Modpacks
You can use this mod in your modpack. You don’t have to ask for permission as long as you credit the author. You cannot upload this mod to other platforms.

**Disclaimer: the Plushies will not be moved into this mod!**
